conclusion: QA report: equal 50 g loads gave a level beam and equal 0.058860000 N m torques. By m_sample = m_reference × L_right/L_left, 50 × 0.120/0.120 = 50 g. Unequal loads can settle at a nonzero angle or contact a stop; neither establishes level balance. Gravity changes forces, while equal-arm mass comparison remains unchanged. The model excludes pan swing, bearing friction, buoyancy and instrument calibration.
note: QA evidence: extending the release to 60 s allowed the 50/49 g comparison to settle away from level.
